1Q2026 FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS
Core profit grew 27% YoY, supported by EBITDA growth, while a weaker Baht moderated net profit
Thai AirAsia delivered outstanding performance 
with improved profitability in 1Q2026. The surge in 
jet fuel prices from the Middle East conflict began 
to be realised from April 2026 onward.
• Revenues from sales and services were 13,530 
MTHB, +2% YoY, mainly from capacity growth.
• EBITDA remained strong at 3,734 MTHB, up 11% 
YoY, with a 28% EBITDA margin, up 3 ppts YoY.
• Net profit was 841 MTHB, representing a 6% 
margin, pressured by the weaker baht currency.
• Excluding FX gain/(loss), core profit was 1,652 
MTHB, +27% YoY, a strong 12% margin.
* EBITDA excluded gain (loss) on FX, derivatives, disposals, and provision for impairment
** Core profit (loss) = Net profit (loss) excluding after-tax FX gain (loss)
